4050-7084-8338.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing another nonland creature you control, adding one mana of any color
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the land, adding one mana of any color
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Shuttlecraft Galileo triggers, creating a 1/1 red Officer creature token
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2511-6972-8329--225.easyPrerequisites: The Zombie Cat doesn't have a -1/-1 counter on it and has base toughness 2 or greater.
2511-6972-8329--225.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing the Zombie Cat.
When the Zombie Cat dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the Zombie Cat enters, Olag and Miau's first and second abilities trigger.
Resolve the first trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on the Zombie Cat.
Resolve the second trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on either a Zombie or Cat you control.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Bloodflow Connoisseur
Repeat.
2511-6972-8329--225.notes: You can use either Olag and Miau trigger to put a +1/+1 counter on the Zombie Cat. The other ability can put the counter on any Zombie or Cat you control depending on which trigger is left.

643-5641-8329.description:
Cast Basking Broodscale by paying its mana cost.
When Basking Broodscale enters, Olag and Miau's first and second abilities each trigger, as Basking Broodscale is both a Zombie and a Cat due to Maskwood Nexus.
Resolve the first trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on any creature you wish.
Resolve the second trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
When the creature token enters, Olag and Miau's first and second abilities trigger.
Repeat from step 3.

464-7268.easyPrerequisites: Fraying Sanity is attached to an opponent.
464-7268.description:
Cast Kitsune's Technique by paying {4}{U}{U}, causing an opponent to mill half their library, rounded up.
At the beginning of your end step, Fraying Sanity triggers, causing the opponent to mill cards equal to the number of cards put into their graveyard this turn.

5078-5741-7060-8171.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Vraska triggers, creating a 1/1 Sculpture Treasure artifact creature token.
Activate the token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

183-1003-3652-6516.easyPrerequisites:
It is an opponent's turn.
One of the {0}-cost creatures must be in your hand, with the other being on the battlefield.
183-1003-3652-6516.description:
During an opponent's turn, cast the {0}-cost creature in your hand by paying {0}.
Glen Elendra Pranksters triggers, returning the other {0}-cost creature from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the spell from step 1.
Repeat.

955-1368-5477-6321.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three other cards in your graveyard.
955-1368-5477-6321.description:
Cast Malevolent Rumble for its escape cost by paying {1}{G} and exiling three other cards from your graveyard, causing you to mill at least three cards and create a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

5641-6823-7743.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
5641-6823-7743.description:
Gain life.
Heroic Feast triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Aunt May triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

1491-2757-6218-7741.description:
Activate Earthcraft by tapping Pheres-Band Tromper, untapping a basic land.
Activate a basic land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Pheres-Band Tromper by paying {1} and putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Pheres-Band Tromper triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Repeat.

2092-2757-5140-6261.description:
Activate a basic Swamp by tapping it, adding {B}.
Activate Kenrith's fifth ability by paying {B} due to Agatha, returning Bulwark Ox from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping Bulwark Ox, untapping the basic Swamp.
Activate Bulwark Ox by sacrificing it.
Repeat.

2173-2448-5220-6772.easyPrerequisites: It is your precombat main phase.
2173-2448-5220-6772.description:
Activate Goblin Firestarter by sacrificing it.
When Goblin Firestarter dies, Mortuary and Syr Vondam trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Goblin Firestarter from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Syr Vondam trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and putting a +1/+1 counter on Syr Vondam.
Resolve the Goblin Firestarter ability.
Cast Goblin Firestarter from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

uses.n: Heliod, the Radiant Dawn // Heliod, the Warped Eclipse

141-4668-7101.notablePrerequisites: Opponents have drawn at least 2 cards this turn.
141-4668-7101.description:
Cast Airbending Lesson by paying its mana cost reduced by Heliod, targeting any applicable target(s).
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost reduced by Heliod
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, copying Airbending Lesson targeting Naru Meha.
Resolve Airbending Lesson, airbending Naru Meha.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha from exile by paying {0} due to Heliod
Repeat from step 3.

3713-4311-5078-5268.description:
Activate Battered Golem by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Battered Golem triggers, untapping Battered Golem.
Repeat.

3661-4053-5686-6989.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Shield Sphere.
Cast Shield Sphere from your graveyard by paying {0}. It will not enter with a finality counter on it due to Solemnity.
Repeat.

5805-6797--5.notablePrerequisites: At least one opponent has lost life this turn.
5805-6797--5.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing the creature with persist.
The persist ability triggers, returning that creature to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it, as well as a +1/+1 counter due to Gev.
The +1/+1 and -1/-1 counters on that creature are removed as a state-based action.
Resolve the ability from step 1.
Repeat.

2457-2557-5794-6753.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating four 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate Baylen's first ability twice by tapping the four Insect tokens, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat.

565-1858-2633--118.notablePrerequisites:
You control an animated land without summoning sickness that enters the battlefield untapped and can tap to produce at least {U}.
You control a white permanent.
565-1858-2633--118.description:
Activate an animated land by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Cast View from Above by paying {1}{U}, targeting the animated land.
Orvar and Urabrask trigger.
Resolve the Urabrask trigger, adding {R} and dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Resolve the Orvar trigger, creating a token copy of the animated land that is not a creature.
Resolve View from Above, returning it to your hand.
Activate the land token by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Repeat from step 2.

222-413-527-5295.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
222-413-527-5295.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Selvala.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee and Selvala enter, Slimefoot and Squee triggers once and Blasting Station triggers twice.
Resolve both Blasting Station triggers, untapping it.
Holding priority, activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Slimefoot and Squee.
Resolve the Slimefoot and Squee trigger, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
When the Saproling enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Repeat.

1737-3698-4853-5004.description:
Activate Prototype Portal by paying {3} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Cathodion.
When the token Cathodion enters, Grinding Station triggers, untapping itself.
Activate Grinding Station by sacrificing Cathodion and tapping it.
When Cathodion dies, Cathodion and Dross Scorpion trigger.
Resolve the Cathodion trigger, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Resolve the Dross Scorpion trigger, untapping Prototype Portal.
Resolve the Grinding Station ability,  causing target player to mill three cards.
Repeat.

1308-3129-5658-6245.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
You have the city's blessing or control at least six permanents.
1308-3129-5658-6245.description:
Declare Satya as an attacker. Satya triggers, creating four token copies of Ocelot Pride that are tapped and attacking and causing you to get {E}{E}.
If you don't have the city's blessing, the Ocelot Pride token gives you the city's blessing.
At the beginning of your end step, Satya triggers four times, and each Ocelot Pride you control triggers once.
Resolve the first Ocelot Pride trigger, causing you to create three 1/1 Cat creature tokens if you gained life this turn, and then causing you to create three token copies of each creature token that entered the battlefield under your control this turn, and then causing you to create a token copy of each noncreature token that entered the battlefield under your control this turn.
Repeat step 4 for each remaining trigger.
1308-3129-5658-6245.notes: You may repeat this loop during subsequent turns to get even more creature tokens and ETB triggers.

3812-3990-5963.notablePrerequisites:
You control a land that can tap to produce {U}.
Marvin does not have summoning sickness and has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
3812-3990-5963.description:
Activate Marvin using Incubation Druid's ability by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Marvin using Simic Ragworm's ability by paying {U}, untapping it.
Repeat.

uses.n: The Enigma Jewel // Locus of Enlightenment

74-573-943.description:
Activate Gruul Turf by tapping it, adding {R}{G}.
Activate Deserted Temple's second ability by paying {1} and tapping it, targeting itself.
Locus of Enlightenment triggers, copying Deserted Temple's ability, targeting Gruul Turf.
Resolve both Deserted Temple abilities, untapping it and Gruul Turf.
Repeat.
74-573-943.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may untap any other land except Gruul Turf instead.

1615-1623-5907.notablePrerequisites: There is another spell with mana value 3 or less on the stack.
1615-1623-5907.description:
Cast Mesmeric Glare by paying {2}{U}, targeting another spell with mana value 3 or less currently on the stack.
Lucky Clover triggers, copying Mesmeric Glare, with the copy targeting the original Mesmeric Glare.
Resolve the copy of Mesmeric Glare, causing you to exile the original Mesmeric Glare, and cast it from exile without paying its mana cost, targeting another spell with mana value 3 or less due to Guile.
Repeat from step 2.

2730-2921-3719-5131.notablePrerequisites:
Kaya's Ghostform attached to Muldrotha.
You have not cast a creature spell using Muldrotha this turn if Ruthless Technomancer is in your graveyard.
2730-2921-3719-5131.description:
Cast Ruthless Technomancer either from your hand or graveyard by paying {3}{B}.
When Ruthless Technomancer enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice Muldrotha and create six Treasure artifact tokens.
When Muldrotha dies, Kaya's Ghostform triggers, returning Muldrotha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Ruthless Technomancer, putting a +1/+1 counter of Bartolomé del Presidio.
Activate five Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}{B}{B}.
Cast Kaya's Ghostform from your graveyard by paying {B}, attaching it to Muldrotha.
Repeat.

971-2060-3859-5283.notablePrerequisites:
Crystalline Crawler has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
Pentad Prism has at least one charge counter on it.
971-2060-3859-5283.description:
Cast Cavern Harpy by paying {U}{B}.
Inexorable Tide triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Crystalline Crawler and a charge counter on Pentad Prism.
When Cavern Harpy enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Pentad Prism by removing a charge counter from it, adding {B}.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {U}.
Repeat.

1988-4050-4186.notablePrerequisites:
Blade of the Bloodchief attached to Scurry Oak.
You control at least one additional creature.
1988-4050-4186.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing another creature, adding one mana of any color.
When the creature dies, Blade of the Bloodchief triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
Repeat.

1283-2440-2609.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three Soldiers.
1283-2440-2609.description:
Cast Recruit the Worthy with buyback by paying {4}, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token and returning Recruit the Worthy to your hand.
When the Soldier enters the battlefield, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {1} for each Soldier you control.
Repeat.

856-5256-5270.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Cauldron Familiar enters the battlefield, it and Samwise triggers.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain one life.
Resolve the Samwise trigger, creating a Food token.
Repeat.

3492-3609-4331.notablePrerequisites: Drafna and Coretapper do not have summoning sickness.
3492-3609-4331.description:
Activate Coretapper's first ability by tapping it, putting a charge counter on Magistrate's Scepter.
Activate Drafna's first ability by paying {1}{U}, returning Coretapper from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Coretapper by paying {2}.
Holding priority, activate Drafna's second ability by paying {3} and tapping it, copying the Coretapper spell.
Activate the Coretapper token's second ability by sacrificing it, putting two charge counters on Magistrate's Scepter.
Activate Magistrate's Scepter's second ability by tapping it and removing three charge counters from it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

2758-3525-4474.notablePrerequisites:
Pemmin's Aura and Paradise Mantle attached to Grimoire Thief.
Grimoire Thief does not have summoning sickness.
2758-3525-4474.description:
Activate Grimoire Thief by tapping it, adding {U}.
Grimoire Thief triggers, exiling the top three cards of an opponent's library face down.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {U}, untapping Grimoire Thief.
Repeat.

2-2034-3129-5043.description:
Cast Ancestral Statue by paying {4}.
Alela triggers, creating two 1/1 Faerie creature tokens.
Ancestral Statue enters the battlefield, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing the two Faeries, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.

933-957-2556.description:
Cast Time Stretch by paying {8}{U}{U}, taking an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, Conjurer's Closet triggers, blinking Mnemonic Wall.
Mnemonic Wall enters the battlefield, returning Time Stretch from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
